blogPosts.title: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): How to Rank in ChatGPT, Gemini & Google AI Overviews
blogPosts.excerpt: Traditional SEO is evolving into AI Discovery. Learn the exact technical markup, entity authority, and brand citation strategies required to get cited in ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews.
blogPosts.content:
## The Shift from 10 Blue Links to AI Answer Engines
Search is experiencing its biggest paradigm shift in 25 years. Large Language Models (LLMs) like ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Perplexity are directly synthesizing answers for millions of commercial queries.

### 01. What is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)?
GEO is the discipline of optimizing brand entities, content structure, and technical citation graphs so that AI models choose your brand when users ask questions like 'What is the best digital marketing agency for fintech in India?'.

### 02. The 3 Core Pillars of GEO
- **Entity Clarity & Knowledge Graph Nodes**: Structured Schema.org Organization markup with verified sameAs profiles.
- **Direct Fact & Data Citations**: Including proprietary statistics and original research that LLMs ingest.
- **High-Authority Brand Co-Occurrences**: Mentions across reputable trade publications and digital PR outlets.

> 💡 **Key Takeaway:** Brands that build authority citations today will capture 80% of AI-driven commercial search volume over the next 3 years.

blogPosts.content:
## Why Ad Accounts Plateau at Scale
When ad budgets scale, audience saturation and ad fatigue cause customer acquisition costs (CAC) to spike. Winning at scale requires moving away from minor bid tweaks to high-volume creative iteration.

### 01. The Weekly Creative Sprint Engine
- **4 Hook Angles Weekly**: Testing Problem-Agitation, Direct Demo, Social Proof, and Contrarian viewpoints.
- **Dynamic Landing Page Routing**: Sending traffic to tailored sub-second landing pages rather than a generic homepage.
- **Server-Side Conversion API (CAPI)**: Ensuring Meta and Google algorithms receive 100% accurate purchase signals.

> 💡 **Key Takeaway:** In modern paid advertising, creative *is* targeting. The brand that tests 15 creative angles weekly will consistently beat the competitor testing only 2.

blogPosts.title: Core Web Vitals & Sub-Second Page Speed: The Unfair SEO & CRO Advantage
blogPosts.excerpt: A 1-second delay in page load drops mobile conversions by 26%. Discover how sub-second React architecture compounds organic rankings and doubles landing page conversion rates.
blogPosts.content:
## Mobile Speed is Commercial Revenue
In India, over 82% of commercial traffic originates on mobile networks. If your website takes 3.5 seconds to load, over a third of your paid clicks bounce before seeing your value proposition.

### 01. The Three Critical Metrics
- **LCP (Largest Contentful Paint)**: Under 1.2 seconds for optimal user retention.
- **INP (Interaction to Next Paint)**: Ensuring instant tactile feedback on buttons.
- **CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift)**: Zero visual jumping during font and image loading.

> 💡 **Key Takeaway:** Upgrading to a modern, headless React architecture pays for itself within 60 days through higher organic rankings and reduced cost-per-lead.
